licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score: Si mora si (no accent), oh Dei, Don Alfonso's “in pocchi istanti” (the libretto has pochi) and “il tristo effetto” (the libretto has triste), nè, and o il labbro.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 152–158, bars 62–137 of No. 18
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the No. 18 Finale (697 bars) read in fifteen page ranges, sung lines and piano each by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the zoomed page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by nine fresh proofreaders (three fixes on pages 148–154, the rest clean). The German singing translation is left out. All the singers of this section have a staff throughout, with rests where the print leaves a staff out; singers who do not sing in this section are left out. Cut from the one-file finale at bars 62–137: from the Allegro (G major, alla breve) to the double bar before the change to E flat; bar 1 is also the last bar of “Ah che tutta in un momento”, and the sisters' “me” on its first beat belongs to that piece. The 4/4 from bar 45 is as printed. Playback tempo ♩ = 166 from René Jacobs's recording (harmonia mundi), whose track for bars 1–291 lasts 7:35.
